info.name: Inventory API — scenarios
info.description: Run `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`, start `php artisan serve`, then Run collection from the top. Steps depend on each other. For every endpoint and field, see the generated docs at /docs/api.

item.name: Setup — log in
item.description: Run `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` first. These save the tokens for every later request.

item.name: Phase 1 — Auth, users and errors
item.description: Login, the current user, logout, user management and the error format.

exec: pm.test("errors.email.0 = \"These credentials do not match our records.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["email"][0]).to.eql("These credentials do not match our records."));
pm.test("errors.email.0 = \"The email field is required.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["email"][0]).to.eql("The email field is required."));
pm.test("errors.password.0 = \"The password field is required.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["password"][0]).to.eql("The password field is required."));

item.name: Log in on a second device

request.description: device_name is optional; it names the token.
Only this token is revoked; the owner token still works.

item.name: The logged-out token no longer works

exec: pm.test("errors.email.0 = \"The email has already been taken.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["email"][0]).to.eql("The email has already been taken."));

item.name: The new user can log in

exec: pm.test("message = \"This action is unauthorized.\"", () => pm.expect(j["message"]).to.eql("This action is unauthorized."));
pm.test("message = \"Resource not found.\"", () => pm.expect(j["message"]).to.eql("Resource not found."));

item.name: Phase 2 — Master data
item.description: Categories, products, suppliers, customers and accounts. Creates its own records so later folders are unaffected.

item.name: Anyone logged in can list categories

exec: pm.test("errors.name.0 = \"The name has already been taken.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["name"][0]).to.eql("The name has already been taken."));
pm.test("data.description = \"Pipes, fittings and taps\"", () => pm.expect(j["data"]["description"]).to.eql("Pipes, fittings and taps"));

request.description: Money always comes back as a string with two decimals.

exec: pm.test("errors.sku.0 = \"The sku has already been taken.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["sku"][0]).to.eql("The sku has already been taken."));

item.name: Prices have at most two decimals

exec: pm.test("errors.cost_price.0 = \"The cost price field must have 0-2 decimal places.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["cost_price"][0]).to.eql("The cost price field must have 0-2 decimal places."));

item.name: A category with products cannot be deleted

exec: pm.test("message = \"This category still has products and cannot be deleted.\"", () => pm.expect(j["message"]).to.eql("This category still has products and cannot be deleted."));

request.description: Staff can register customers for credit sales.

exec: pm.test("errors.phone.0 = \"The phone has already been taken.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["phone"][0]).to.eql("The phone has already been taken."));

pm.test("errors.opening_balance.0 = \"The opening balance cannot be changed. Record an adjustment instead.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["opening_balance"][0]).to.eql("The opening balance cannot be changed. Record an adjustment instead."));

item.name: Phase 3 — Stock
item.description: Stock is the sum of stock movements. Uses the product from phase 2 and brings it back to zero.

exec: pm.test("message = \"Not enough stock for PIPE-1: 20 on hand, 25 requested.\"", () => pm.expect(j["message"]).to.eql("Not enough stock for PIPE-1: 20 on hand, 25 requested."));
pm.test("errors.note.0 = \"A reason is required for every stock adjustment.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["note"][0]).to.eql("A reason is required for every stock adjustment."));

item.name: A product with stock cannot be deleted

exec: pm.test("message = \"This product still has 20 in stock. Adjust stock to zero before deleting it.\"", () => pm.expect(j["message"]).to.eql("This product still has 20 in stock. Adjust stock to zero before deleting it."));

item.name: Now the product can be deleted
Its category still cannot be deleted

request.description: Deleted products still belong to the category, so their history stays intact.

item.name: Phase 4 — Purchases and sales
item.description: Seed IDs: products 1 cement, 2 nails, 3 paint; supplier 1; customer 1; accounts 1 cash, 2 bank.

request.description: Total is computed by the server. The product's cost price becomes 950.

item.name: Product cost follows the last purchase

exec: pm.test("message = \"This action is unauthorized.\"", () => pm.expect(j["message"]).to.eql("This action is unauthorized."));

item.name: Staff sells to a walk-in, paid in full

request.description: No unit_price sent: the selling price is used. Staff never see unit_cost.

item.name: Credit sale with a negotiated price
Walk-in sale must be paid in full

exec: pm.test("message = \"A customer is required for a sale that is not fully paid.\"", () => pm.expect(j["message"]).to.eql("A customer is required for a sale that is not fully paid."));

item.name: Cannot sell more than in stock

exec: pm.test("message = \"Not enough stock for PNT-W4: 59 on hand, 1000 requested.\"", () => pm.expect(j["message"]).to.eql("Not enough stock for PNT-W4: 59 on hand, 1000 requested."));

pm.test("errors.items\\.1\\.product_id.0 = \"Each product may appear only once on a document.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["items.1.product_id"][0]).to.eql("Each product may appear only once on a document."));

item.name: Phase 5 — Money
item.description: Balances are calculated from the ledger, never stored.

item.name: Staff collects the rest of the credit sale

exec: pm.test("message = \"This action is unauthorized.\"", () => pm.expect(j["message"]).to.eql("This action is unauthorized."));

item.name: Payment above the balance due is refused

exec: pm.test("message = \"Payment (8000.00) exceeds the balance due on PUR-000001 (7800.00).\"", () => pm.expect(j["message"]).to.eql("Payment (8000.00) exceeds the balance due on PUR-000001 (7800.00)."));
pm.test("errors.note.0 = \"A reason is required for every expense.\"", () => pm.expect(j["errors"]["note"][0]).to.eql("A reason is required for every expense."));

item.name: Reconcile the till to the counted amount

request.description: Net worth = money + inventory at cost + receivables - payables.
